source.note: Per-token-class energy back-solved from Epoch AI's GPT-4o estimates, in three context cases: typical short (input ~110 / output ~540 Wh/MTok), medium context ~10k tokens (~200 / ~990), maximum context ~100k tokens (~390 / ~1,950). Couch used the ~100k case for coding agents, which run long contexts; it is the central here and the ~10k case the low end.
